name: app-service
description: Managed web hosting with built-in CI/CD, auto-scaling, and custom domains

defaultConfig.note: B1 for dev/low scale, P1v3 for production high-scale. Linux recommended for Python/Node.

F1.note: Free, 60min/day CPU, no custom domains, no always-on

integration.identityNote: Create a user-assigned managed identity. Assign it to the web app AND grant it RBAC on all downstream services.

connectsTo.description: App Service connects to downstream services via managed identity + env vars. For each downstream service, the Bicep must: (1) pass managedIdentityPrincipalId to the service's role assignment, (2) inject the service endpoint URL as an app setting.
connectsTo.wirePattern:
For each service in the template:
1. Provision the service (Cosmos, Redis, Storage, etc.)
2. Create RBAC role assignment: service → managedIdentity.principalId
3. Inject the service's endpoint into App Service appSettings
4. App code reads env var and uses DefaultAzureCredential

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

# DefaultAzureCredential picks up the managed identity automatically
# Set AZURE_CLIENT_ID app setting to the managed identity client ID
credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
